About MRUS

Built around independent thinking.

MRUS Consulting is an independent engineering consulting firm specializing in MEP peer review and value engineering for large-scale real estate and construction projects.

We review construction drawings prepared by design engineers, identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising code compliance or building performance, and deliver detailed written reports with quantified savings estimates.

MRUS supports developers and ownership groups on high-rise residential, mixed-use and commercial projects in Miami, across the United States, and internationally.
